Darkness Rise
EFFECT RADIUS:
375
Innate: Mordekaiser's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. Innate: Mordekaiser generates a stack for each enemy champion or monster hit by his basic attacks and basic abilities, which lasts a few seconds. At max stacks, he gains Darkness Rise. Darkness Rise: Mordekaiser gains  bonus movement speed and creates an aura that continually deals magic damage to nearby enemies based on their maximum health.
Innate: Mordekaiser's basic attacks are empowered to deal 40% AP bonus magic damage on-hit.
Innate: Mordekaiser generates a stack for each enemy champion or large monster damaged by his basic attacks or hit by his basic abilities, lasting for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent triggers, and stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, he gains Darkness Rise.
Darkness Rise: Mordekaiser gains  3% / 6% / 9% / 12% (based on level) bonus movement speed and deals「 5 (+ 30% AP) (+ 1% – 5.47% (based on level) of target's maximum health) magic damage every second 」「 0.625 (+ 3.75% AP) (+ 0.13% – 0.68% (based on level) of target's maximum health) magic damage every 0.125 seconds 」to nearby enemies. Against monsters, the damage is capped at「 40 – 218.82 (based on level) per second. 」「 5 – 25 (based on level) per 0.125 seconds. 」

  • Darkness Rise deals persistent area damage damage around Mordekaiser, while the bonus damage on his basic attacks is proc damage.
  • Darkness Rise's bonus damage on-hit is not applied against structures.
  • Mordekaiser has a stack counter under his health bar that is not visible to other champions. It will light up when the maximum effect is active.
  • Mordekaiser will still generate Darkness Rise stacks from hitting his abilities even if they deal no damage, such as if the target is invulnerable or blocks an ability with a spell shield.
  • Basic attacks do not generate a stack if their damage event does not happen due to the target being invulnerable, or the attack being dodged, blocked, or missed while Mordekaiser is blinded.
  • Dusk and Dawn's Spellblade on-hit event is special cased to generate an additional Darkness Rise stack.
    • The on-hit event is not triggered if the triggering attack is dodged, blocked, or missed while Mordekaiser is blinded, thus not generating a Darkness Rise stack.
  • Darkness Rise's area damage alone does not refresh Darkness Rise's buff.
  • If Darkness Rise is activated through either Obliterate or Death's Grasp, it will be treated as the same cast instance as the triggering spell.(unexpected)
    • Under these conditions, Darkness Rise will fail to interact with effects that only do so once per cast instance (e.g Conqueror), but will interact with effects such as Spear of Shojin's Focused Will's stacking, which would normally not interact with innate abilities.[1]
    • Darkness Rise's damage will be grouped with the triggering spell's damage in the death recap.[2]

Passive: Mordekaiser stores a portion of the damage he deals and receives as Potential Shield, up to a portion of his maximum health. This begins to decay after a brief time without fighting. Active: Mordekaiser converts his Potential Shield to shield himself for a few seconds, which decays over time. Indestructible can be recast while the shield is active. Recast: Mordekaiser consumes the remaining shield, healing for a portion of the amount.
Passive: Mordekaiser stores 45% of the post-mitigation damage he deals and 7.5% of the pre-mitigation damage he takes,「 reduced by 75% for non-champion sources, 」「 reduced to 11.25% of damage dealt and 3.75% of damage taken for non-champion sources, 」as Potential Shield on his secondary resource bar, up to  30% of his maximum health. The Potential Shield decays by 8 – 25 (based on level) every second after not dealing or taking damage for 1 second. While Indestructible is not on cooldown, the Potential Shield will not decay below a minimum of 5% of his maximum health, and it will be set to that amount when it comes off cooldown if it was previously below it.
Active: Mordekaiser consumes his Potential Shield to grant himself a shield for the same amount for 4 seconds. The shield decays exponentially over the duration. Indestructible can be recast after 0.5 seconds while the shield is active.
Recast: Mordekaiser consumes the remaining shield, healing for a portion of the amount.

Realm of Death

Active: Mordekaiser slows the target enemy champion, then banishes them with him to the Death Realm for a few seconds, cancelling all interactions with non-banished units. Additionally, Mordekaiser heals himself for a portion of the target's maximum health and temporarily steals a portion of their current  attack damage,  ability power,  total attack speed,  maximum health,  armor,  magic resist, and size. If the target dies while inside the Death Realm, Mordekaiser keeps his stolen stats until they respawn. Death Realm: The Death Realm confines units in a small area. Allies and enemies cannot see or interact with those in the Death Realm but can see their locations and vice versa.
Active: Mordekaiser aims his mace towards the target enemy champion, slowing them by 75% and revealing them over the cast time, and then banishing them with him to the Death Realm for 7 seconds.

Mordekaiser also consumes the target's soul for 7 seconds, healing himself for 10% of their maximum health and reducing their current  ability power,  total attack speed,  maximum health,  armor,  magic resistance, and size by 10% for the duration. Additionally, the target's  base attack damage is reduced by 10% of their current total AD for the same duration. Mordekaiser gains the reduced stats of the target for himself for the same duration, and if the target dies while inside the Death Realm, he keeps their partial stats until they respawn.
Units between realms see each other as spirits, considering each other dead and negating any interactions between each other. Only Mordekaiser and the target will enter the realm; other champions cannot follow them. Everything that occurs inside the Death Realm is hidden to units outside of it, and vice versa. Most pets still inside the realm are killed at its end.
If one of the two affected champions leave the Death Realm, because of having died or having it dispelled, the other will do so as well.
"Welcome to oblivion."

See Notes
  • The Death Realm is a battlefield that exists outside of the normal realm in an alternate "dimension". It exists only for Mordekaiser and his target. It consists of an arena that has a radius of 1200 units and includes any terrain features that would exist in the map of the normal realm, including walls and brushes.
    • The boundaries of the arena are impassable but not considered terrain themselves ( Unstoppable Onslaught exception), and enemies that try to move out of the area will be displaced back inside.
    • Dashes, blinks, displacements and other forms of movement will cap their effect range to the boundary. Targets will stop at the boundary even after it expired.
    • During the cast time of Realm of Death, it is possible to pathfind outside the boundaries of the arena by issuing a movement command toward an area that becomes inaccessible due to terrain inside the Death Realm.(bug)[4]
  • Realm of Death retains Mordekaiser's previous current health percentage when granting him a portion of the target's maximum health.
  • Realm of Death's healing is affected by healing modifiers.
  • Realm of Death does not trigger in-combat effects.
  • Realm of Death will cancel and go on cooldown after its cast time if:
    • The target is displacement immune, crowd control immune or protected by a spell shield.
      • Note that all of the above are ineffective if they are applied after the target has been banished.
    • The target is a clone or Sion when his Glory in Death is active.
  • If the target becomes untargetable, dies, is too far away or Mordekaiser loses sight of them due to nearsight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown.
  • If either Mordekaiser or the target dies at the same time of the transition into the Death Realm, the Death Realm will not end prematurely and will continue until its full duration has ended.(bug)[5]
    • If the target dies this way, Mordekaiser will not keep their stats after leaving the Death Realm.
    • Tahm Kench's Devour will always trigger this bug if used during the cast of Realm of Death and the spit would kill Mordekaiser.[6]
  • If Mordekaiser or the target cast another Realm of Death, the affected champions will remain stuck for the duration of the new circle.
    • The previous circle will be overridden by the new one; it will be dispelled to enter the new circle.
  • Spell shield will not block the initial slow.
  • The reveal effect lasts for 1.25 seconds from the start of the cast time if the cast does not complete. Otherwise, the reveal ends as soon as the cast time completes.
  • Upon entering or leaving the Death Realm, targets revealed by effects such as Ignite or Ashe's Hawkshot will keep the reveal VFX but will stop being revealed.(bug)[7]
  • If the target's  health is lower than the amount that should be stolen, they will be brought down to 1 health. Mordekaiser will still get the intended amount of maximum health.
  • If the target's  health is higher than their  health after the reduction, they will lose the excess HP on top of taking 10% of their maximum health as damage. This happens because Realm of Death first reduces 10% of the target's maximum health, and then deals an additional 10% of their maximum health as damage.
  • Realm of Death's maximum health reduction ignores invulnerability effects.
  • Entering or leaving the Death Realm will cause all targeted projectiles to be destroyed.
  • The transition in and out of the Death Realm doesn't interrupt channels.
    • Grand Starfall will always be interrupted by the transition into the realm.
  • Realm of Death will not be dispelled if either of the two affected champions enter resurrection after taking lethal damage. It is dispelled if the target enters a zombie state.
  • Any active tether effects (both friendly and hostile ones) existing on either of the two champions entering the realm will be broken (unless the tether is between those two).
  • Upon entering the realm, Mordekaiser and the target are cleansed from all forced action effects.
    • The cleanse will occur even if the source of the crowd control enters the realm.(unexpected)
  • Unlike the other stats, Mordekaiser does not steal enemy total size; instead he gains 10% of his own size and reduces the enemy's size by 10% of theirs (all size modifiers stack additively).
    • Mordekaiser grows in size over 0.25 seconds after successfully stealing his targets' stats, and shrinks over 0.25 seconds after the buff runs out again. The target shrinks over 0.25 seconds after their stats are stolen, but grows back to normal size instantly when the effect ends.
  • While Mordekaiser has hold of his enemy's stats, that champion's circular portrait will appear as a pip next to his health bar, visible to all players.
    • The champion's portrait will ocasionally stay even after Mordekaiser has lost hold of the enemy's stats.(bug)
  • Realm of Death's interactions with other elements/abilities (This list might be incomplete, last updated on patch V26.05):
    • Multiple Death Realms (possible through a hijacked Realm of Death or if multiple Mordekaisers are in the same match) spawned will exist in the same realm, allowing champions to see and interact with champions bound to other circles. Champions are only affected by their boundaries and are not able to see the others.
      • If another Realm of Death is cast while one is already active, upon leaving, the spirits from the second Realm of Death will be invisible from the perspective of the players affected by the first Realm of Death.(bug)[8]
      • Tahm Kench's Devour can carry a target outside of their circle, but they will be displaced back inside once Regurgitated.
      • An active Cease and Desist on a target outside the perimeter will cause Vi to continue her charge until her circle ends. She can knock back and damage secondary targets multiple times.
    • Champions inside the Death Realm continue gaining gold and  experience from any source, which includes nearby and global bounties as well as neutral buffs.
    • Structures exist in all realms at the same time. Turrets will behave normally as if all units were in the same realm.
    • Turret's Crystalline Overgrowth can still be triggered while inside the Death Realm.
      • The Overgrowth's VFX of the Outer Turrets (Tier 1) will be invisible inside the Death Realm.(bug)[9]
    • The faelights and jungle plants ( Blast Cone, Honeyfruit, Scryer's Bloom) will not be present in the Death Realm.
      • The faelights indicator will still be visible if the player's cursor is placed in their location.(bug)[10]
      • The Blast Cone's landing indicator will still be visible while in the Death Realm and within its range.(bug)[11]
    • Epic monsters, with the exception of Voidgrub's, will be visible for a brief moment after entering the Death Realm, but they will be untargetable.(bug)[12]
    • Hex-gates on Hextech Rift will not be present between realms.
    • Eye of the Herald and Teleport are disabled while in the Death Realm.
      • Using Unsealed Spellbook to swap Teleport for another summoner spell while in the Death Realm will disable the new summoner spell until the user leaves the realm.(bug)[13]
    • Controllable pets and clones can still be commanded between realms.
    • Mordekaiser will be given gold, if applicable, for pets killed at the end of Realm of Death.
      • Illaoi's Tentacles will not be killed at the end of Realm of Death.(unexpected)
    • Annie's Tibbers, Heimerdinger's H-28Q Apex Turret, Ivern's Daisy and Yorick's Maiden are considered as "large pets" for the purposes of this ability and will follow their respective champions between realms.
      • If Mordekaiser dies inside of the Death Realm while his Darkness Rise is hitting any of these pets, Darkness Rise will keep affecting the pets until they die or Darkness Rise deactivates normally.(bug)[14]
    • Switching realms detaches all attached champions on either of the two champions entering the realm.
    • The allied health, resource, and ultimate indicators (champion portraits located on the screen) will not update between realms as the players have no vision of them.
    • Pings used in the Death Realm will appear in the chat and mini-map, but will not appear in the map.(unexpected)
    • Any spawned terrain while in the Death Realm will remain inside until expired. They will not be destroyed.
    • Except for some cases, spells that require a target to be cast (e.g Akali's Shuriken Flip, Twitch's Contaminate) will not affect enemies in other realms nor will be castable if there's no targets in the same realm as the caster.
    • Amumu's Bandage Toss, Blitzcrank's Rocket Grab, Leona's Zenith Blade, Nautilus' Dredge Line, Pyke's Bone Skewer and Thresh's Death Sentence will still hit targets if their caster switches realms before they hit.
    • Camille's The Hextech Ultimatum, Dr. Mundo's Goes Where He Pleases, Nunu & Willump's Biggest Snowball Ever! and Absolute Zero, Pyke's Death from Below, Ryze's Realm Warp, Shen's Spirit's Refuge, Taliyah's Worked Ground and Zed's Shadows will follow their caster between realms.
    • Braum's Glacial Fissure[15], Pantheon's Grand Starfall*[16], Singed's Mega Adhesive[17], Varus' Hail of Arrows[18], Yasuo's Wind Wall[19], Ziggs' Satchel Charge*[20] and Zilean's Time Bomb*[21] will follow their caster between realms but will only be visible in the realm they were cast.(bug)
    • Ahri's Orb of Deception will stay in the realm it was cast.
      • The orb will still go back towards Ahri's position.
    • Akshan's Avengerang will stay in the realm it was cast.
      • The boomerang will only go back towards Akshan's position if it was already doing so during the realm switch.
    • Akshan's Comeuppance bullets will get destroyed if he switches realms, even if its target is Mordekaiser.
    • Anivia's Glacial Storm will not be dispelled if Anivia switches realms, but it will only be present in the realm it was cast.
    • Bel'Veth's Void Corals will only be present in the realm they spawned in.
      • If Bel'Veth switches realms while she is consuming a Void Coral, the Void Coral will dissappear and she will not get her True Form nor deal damage to nearby enemies.
    • Camille will still be able to use Hookshot's dash if she switches realms before the spell hits.
    • Ekko's Parallel Convergence will only be visible in the realm it was cast, but he will still be able to trigger the spell's effect from another realm and it will only affect enemies in said realm.(bug)[22]
    • Fizz's Chum the Waters will follow its target between realms.
    • Galio's Winds of War will follow him if the spell was already on the ground before the realm switch, but it will only be visible in the realm it was cast.(bug)[23]
    • Gnar's Boulder Toss boulder will only be visible in the realm it was cast, but he can still pick it up if he goes to its location.(bug)[24]
    • Illaoi's Test of Spirit tether will be destroyed if her target switches realms.
      • Test of Spirit's target will not be made into a Vessel.
    • Irelia's Flawless Duet will be recast automatically when switching realms, and will only affect enemies in the realm it was cast.
    • Ivern's Rootcaller can still be recast if the target is in a different realm than him.
    • Ivern's Brushmaker brushes might be visible for a few seconds after switching realms.(bug)[25]
      • Passing by the position of a brush created by Brushmaker in another realm will make units transparent for a few seconds, but they will still be visible to the enemy team.
    • Kai'Sa's Killer Instinct can only be cast towards enemies in the same realm she is at.
    • Kalista's Fate's Call cannot be cast if her oathsworn is in another realm, but if the spell was cast before entering the Death Realm, it will function as normal and will only affect targets in the oathsworn's realm.
    • Karthus' Requiem will damage enemies in all realms.
    • Kayn's Umbral Trespass will be interrupted and will not deal damage if its target switches realms.
    • Kog'Maw's Void Ooze will follow him between realms.(bug)[26]
      • A part of the VFX will be left in the realm it was cast.
    • Lillia's Lilting Lullaby will only affect enemies in the same realm as her.
    • Lissandra's Glacial Path can still be recast if the spell was initially cast in another realm.
    • Lulu's Pix will follow her between realms.
      • However, if Pix is on another champion, it will visually stay in Lulu's realm but will keep affecting enemies in the Death Realm.(bug)[27]
        • Pix will still be able to return to Lulu as normal, even if her ally's still in the Death Realm.
    • Lux's Final Spark will follow her between realms.
      • The beam's VFX will only be visible in the realm it was cast.(bug)[28]
    • Malzahar's Void Shift is special cased to not resist the slow but instead resist the realm switch after the cast completes.
    • Malzahar's Call of the Void will follow him if used moments before the realm switch. Also, a part of the VFX will be left in the realm it was cast.(bug)[29]
    • Mel's Golden Eclipse will only deal damage to enemies in the same realm she is at the end of the cast.
    • Miss Fortune's Make It Rain will follow her between realms.(bug)[30]
      • The spell's area VFX will not follow.(bug)
    • Naafiri's Hounds' Pursuit dash will still go through if she switches realms during the cast.
    • Nasus' Spirit Fire will stay in the realm it was cast.
      • However, the spell will keep affecting enemies in another realm if they were already affected by it before switching realms and they have not left the spell's area.(bug)[31]
    • Nautilus' Depth Charge will not follow its target between realms.
    • Neeko cannot be targeted by Realm of Death if she is disguised as a non- champion unit.
    • Nilah's Apotheosis will only deal damage to enemies in the realm it was cast.(unexpected)
      • It will still heal/shield targets in Nilah's realm at the end of the cast.
    • Nocturne's Paranoia only applies nearsight to enemy champions in the same realm as him.
    • Orianna's Ball will go back to her after switching realms.
    • Orianna's Command: Shockwave will follow her between realms if her ball is not on the ground.
      • However, if her ball is on the ground, Command: Shockwave will still follow her between realms but its shockwave will be invisible.(bug)[32]
      • Additionally, if Command: Shockwave is buffered while her ball is still flying and she switches realms, Command: Shockwave's will appear on top of Orianna, but the actual shockwave will occur at the location her ball was supposed to land.(bug)[33]
    • Poppy's Keeper's Verdict can send Mordekaiser outside of the Death Realm arena if she uses it during Realm of Death's cast.(bug)[34]
    • Pyke's Phantom Undertow will not follow him if he switches realms while the Phantom is coming back.
    • Rakan's Grand Entrance will follow him between realms, but its initial VFX will not.(bug)[35]
    • Rek'Sai's Tunnels will not follow her between realms.
      • If Rek'Sai is already on a tunnel when switching realms, her dash will not be interrupted.
    • Sion's Decimating Smash VFX will follow him between realms, but the spell will only affect enemies in the realm it was cast.(bug)[36]
    • Soraka's Wish will heal targets in all realms.
    • Swain's Nevermove can still be recast if the target is in another realm, but nothing will happen.(unexpected)
    • Sylas' Abduct will not hit enemies if he switches realms during the spell's animation.
    • Syndra's Force of Will will cancel on realm switch.
    • Syndra's Unleashed Power will only affect enemies in the realm it was cast, even if its target is Mordekaiser.
    • Tahm Kench's Devour target will get spit on realm switch. The target will still be dealt damage by the spit if applicable.
    • Taliyah's Weaver's Wall will get interrupted on realm switch.
    • Taric's Bastion link will be temporarily disabled while in the Death Realm. The link will not break.
    • Thresh's Dark Passage will go back to him on realm switch.
    • Thresh's The Box pillars will be visible in all realms, but it will only affect enemies in the realm it was cast.(bug)[37]
    • Udyr's Wingborne Storm will stay in the realm it was cast.
      • If the storm's target is sent to a different realm than Udyr, the storm will start following him instead.
        • The storm's tracking VFX will stay in its target until the end of the spell.(bug)
    • Urgot's Fear Beyond Death cannot be recast if the target is not in the same realm as him.
      • If the target is being reeled in however, the execution at the end of the channel will take place regardless of the realm either he or the target is in.
    • Viego's Harrowed Path will follow him between realms.(bug)
      • The ground mist will be visible in all realms.(bug)
    • Viktor's Arcane Storm can be redirected with its recast even if Viktor is in a different realm from the singularity.
    • Xayah's Bladecaller cannot call Feathers between realms.
    • Yasuo's Last Breath will be interrupted if its target switches realms, unless the target is Mordekaiser.
    • Yone's Soul Unbound cannot be recast inside of the Death Realm.
    • Yorick's Maiden will not die with him if he dies inside of the Death Realm.(bug)[38]
      • Eulogy of the Isles will still go on cooldown.

    • Cryptbloom's nova will spawn at the user's realm and will only affect targets in said realm.
    • Elixir of Iron and Trailblazer's trails will follow between realms, but they will be invisible.(bug)[39]
    • Iceborn Gauntlet's frost field will follow between realms, but it will be invisible.(bug)[40]
    • Redemption's beam will only affect targets in the realm it was cast, but its SFX will be heard in all realms.(bug)[41]
    • Dark Harvest's souls VFX will not follow between realms, but they will still be reaped succesfully.(bug)[42]
    • Glacial Augment's glacial rays will follow between realms, but they will be invisible.(bug)[43]

Tips & Tricks
  • While in lane, Realm of Death is best used while the target is between you and your turret. This is so the target doesn't have much space to go towards their turret, since the area of the Death Realm is created in front of Mordekaiser, leaving little space to move behind him.

Map-Specific Differences
Nexus Blitz differences edit
  • When certain Events begin, both Mordekaiser and his target immediately leave the Death Realm.
Arena differences edit
  • Heal health ratio changed to 8% of target's maximum health.
  • Percentage of core stats stolen changed to 8%.
  • If Mordekaiser kills his target, he will keep any stolen stats for the remainder of the round.
  • The Ring of Fire is special-cased to not apply its effects against units inside the Death Realm.
  • In the Reckoner Arena battlefield, the pillars will stay visible and will behave as normal inside of Death Realm, with the exception of them being untargetable.
  • Akali's shroud will follow her between realms.(bug)
    • This bug was fixed on patch V14.1, but it is still present in Arena.
  • If someone who enters the Death Realm has the augment Chauffeur, their hitbox will follow their ally, while they appear to stand still at the position where they entered the Death Realm.(bug)
    • Only when they cast an ability, will they visually teleport to their real position. Once the cast of that ability is over, they will visually teleport back to their original position.
  • If the ally of someone who enters the Death Realm has the augment Chauffeur, this ally will follow them into the Death Realm.
    • This ally will only follow the main target out of the Death Realm if they are currently attached or once they reattach.
      • That means that if they have a way to permanently deattach from their ally, they can permanently stay in the Death Realm.(bug)

  • Darkness Rise (Innate)
    • Innate: Mordekaiser's basic attacks deal 40% AP bonus magic damage on-hit.
    • After 3 basic attacks or abilities against enemy champions and large monsters, Mordekaiser gains Darkness Rise for 5 seconds. Further basic attacks and abilities against enemy champions and large monsters refresh the duration.
    • Darkness Rise: Mordekaiser deals 10 – 35.5 (based on level) (+ 30% AP) (+ 1% – 6.1% (based on level) of target's maximum health) magic damage per second to all nearby enemies and gains 5% – 10% (based on level) bonus movement speed.
  • Obliterate (Q)
    • Active: Mordekaiser smashes the area in the target direction, dealing 5 – 139 (based on level) (+ 75 / 95 / 115 / 135 / 155) (+ 60% AP) magic damage to all enemies hit, increased by 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40% if it hits only one enemy.
    • Cooldown: 9 / 7.75 / 6.5 / 5.25 / 4 seconds.
  • Indestructible (W)
    • Passive: Mordekaiser stores 30% of damage he deals and 15% of damage he takes, reduced by 75% against non-champion sources, as Potential Shield on his secondary resource bar, up to 30% of his maximum health. The Potential Shield bar has a minimum of 5% of his maximum health.
    • Active - First Cast: Mordekaiser consumes all his current Potential Shield to shield himself for 4 seconds for the same amount. At start the shield decays very slowly but exponentially increases near the end. After 0.25 seconds he can re-cast the ability.
    • Active - Second Cast: Mordekaiser consumes the remaining shield, healing for 40 / 42.5 / 45 / 47.5 / 50% of the shield.
    • Cooldown: 14 / 13 / 12 / 11 / 10 seconds.
  • Death's Grasp (E)
    • Passive: Mordekaiser gains 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 25% magic penetration.
    • Active: After a small delay, Mordekaiser pulls enemies in the targeted area over a fixed distance, dealing 80 / 95 / 110 / 125 / 140 (+ 60% AP) magic damage.
    • Cooldown: 24 / 21 / 18 / 15 / 12 seconds.
  • Realm of Death (R)
    • Active: Mordekaiser slows the targeted enemy champion by 75% for 0.5 seconds. If the target is still in range and targetable by the end of the duration they're banished together with Mordekaiser to the Death Realm for 7 seconds, during which they cannot leave.
    • Units between realms see each other as spirits, considering each other dead and negating any interactions between the two. Only the target and Mordekaiser will enter the realm, other champions cannot follow them. Everything that occurs inside the Death Realm is hidden, and all non-champion pets still inside are destroyed at the end.
    • For the same duration Mordekaiser also steals 10% of the target's current size, armor, magic resist, health, attack damage, ability power and attack speed. If Mordekaiser kills his target, he consumes their soul, keeping their partial stats until they respawn.
    • If one of the two affected champions leave the Death Realm, because of having died or having it dispelled, the other will do so as well, but the stats will remain stolen for the full duration.
    • Target Range: 650.
    • Effect Radius: 1200.
    • Cooldown: 140 / 130 / 120 / 110 / 100 seconds.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
Mordekaiser, the Master of Metal
  • Mordekaiser was the only champion without any mobility or crowd control effects until V5.4 onwards where Creeping Death was changed to give him situational bonus movement speed.
  • Mordekaiser might have been responsible for around 80% of all live bugs in League of Legends.[2]
  • Mordekaiser's abilities referenced heavy/thrash metal songs and/or bands:
    • Iron Man by Black Sabbath
    • (M)Ace of Spades by Motörhead
    • Morgenstern (German: 'Morning Star') by Rammstein
    • Harvester of Sorrow by Metallica
      • Creeping Death (Old W) by Metallica
    • Sy(m)phon(y) of Destruction by Megadeth
    • Children of the Grave by Black Sabbath
    • The Prisoner by Iron Maiden
    • DragonForce
    • Mordekaiser's mace references Nightfall by Blind Guardian
  • Mordekaiser used to be one of four champions who use their health as their sole spellcasting resource (the others being Dr. Mundo, Vladimir, and Zac).
  • Children of the Grave used to apply the longest damage-over-time effect in the game (10 seconds).
  • 'Mordekaiser es #1 huehuehue' is the product of 'Brazil 5v5 tier list' by NA Summoner 'SKILLSHOT MASTER' and 'This is why we hate Mordekaiser' by 'McRooster'.
  • Mordekaiser's helmet resembled the M in Sodom's logo.
Mordekaiser, the Iron Revenant
  • His Death's Grasp mirrors Darius' Apprehend: both abilities pull in their targets as well as passively grant their casters magic penetration and armor penetration, respectively.
  • Death's Grasp could be a reference to the item Deathfire Grasp, as both showcase a green claw.
  • The abilities reference metal songs or bands.[3]
    • Obliterate, the grindcore band from Košice.
    • Indestructible, the song by Disturbed.
    • Darkness Rise could be referencing the song, Atlas, Rise by Metallica, or The Rise Of Darkness by Immortal.
    • Realm of Death, Beyond the Realms of Death by Judas Priest.
    • Also, Mordekaiser's mace references Nightfall by Blind Guardian.

A shield adds hitpoints over the unit's  health that absorbs the next instances of damage in place of actual health. This can be improved by various items and effects depending on the type of shielding.

League of Legends content
Attack windup
The attack windup is a portion of the basic attack animation that must play out in order to launch it. For projectile basic attacks, the windup usually aligns with drawing the projectile on-screen.

The attack windup is displayed as a percentage, and any windup modifier is listed as a decimal next to it.

League of Legends content
Attack speed ratio

The Attack speed ratio (AS ratio) adjusts the effectiveness of bonus AS from all sources. It is usually equal to the unit's base AS (level 1 with no bonuses), but tuning to a higher or lower relative value translates to more or less bonus AS received compared to other units with the same base AS.

Total AS = Base AS + Bonus AS × AS Ratio
(All values in decimal form)

The ingame stats HUD displays the AS ratio instead of base AS to communicate this comparative effectiveness. The Wiki opts to always list both stats and show the AS ratio as "N/A" if the two are equal.

League of Legends content
Gameplay radius

A unit's gameplay radius is a stat that most closely resembles the concept of a 'hitbox', and is the radius used for edge range effects, which include basic attacks, line collision missiles, rectangular AOEs, and others. The gameplay radius determines the reach of both incoming and outgoing effects: for example, enemies are within a unit's  basic attack range based on the edge of their gameplay radius and vice versa.

League of Legends content
Selection radius

A unit's selection radius is a stat that determines the horizontally furthest point from the center of their model that other players' cursor is allowed to be, while still maintaining the ability to select that unit.

League of Legends content
Pathing radius

A unit's pathing radius is a stat that determines the gameplay area they occupy for unit-collision and pathfinding logic. A unit's center cannot intersect with another unit's pathing radius, unless one of them is ghosted.

League of Legends content
Selection height
A unit's selection height is a stat that determines the vertically furthest point from the center of their model at the ground that other players' cursor is allowed to be, while still maintaining the ability to select that unit.

Gameplay in League of Legends takes place in two dimensions no matter the visuals. However, a virtual height dimension that is perpendicular to the ground creates the game's three-dimensional view, which in combination with the camera's perspective necessitates the usage of the selection height.

League of Legends content
Acquisition radius

A unit's acquisition range is a stat that determines the distance at which they will acquire basic attack targets when a target unit is not specified by the player.

  • Auto-attacking automatically orders an idle champion to acquire enemies within this range. This can be disabled in the Settings.
  • Attack-move commands scan for targets within this range while moving toward a given location.

Acquisition range is calculated from the champion's edge to the edge of other units.
 Attack range bonuses modify the champion's acquisition range by the same amount.

League of Legends content
Top

Within a drafted team, the Top Laner is the champion assigned to the top lane.

Juggernauts, Divers, Battlemages, Skirmishers, and Vanguards are the most likely champions to be selected in the Top Lane position.

League of Legends content
Juggernaut
Fighters are durable and damage-focused melee champions that look to be in the thick of combat.

Juggernauts are melee titans who relentlessly march down the opposition and devastate those foolish enough to get within their grasp. They are the only subclass who excel at both dealing and taking significant amounts of damage, but in turn they have a tough time closing in on targets due to their low range and extremely limited mobility.

Examples
  • Dr. Mundo
  • Darius
  • Mordekaiser

League of Legends content
Fighter (Legacy)
Fighters are durable and damage-focused melee champions that look to be in the thick of combat.
League of Legends content
Mage (Legacy)

Mages are offensive casters that seek to cripple and burn down the opposition through their potent spells.

League of Legends content
Melee

Melee champions have a basic attack  range usually within 200 units. A melee attack does not use a projectile to deal damage, therefore not subject to effects that mitigate projectiles, like Wind Wall. Some champions can shift between a ranged and melee form, and certain items/runes differ for melee characters.

League of Legends content
Stack
A stack refers to a buff or debuff that can be increased in count under certain circumstances. Stacking effects with durations will refresh per instance, unless otherwise stated.

Stacking effects that time out may cause all stacks to expire at once or one by one in given intervals, depending on the source.

League of Legends content
Champion

Champions are the player-controlled characters in League of Legends. Each champion possesses unique abilities and attributes.

League of Legends content
Monster

Monsters are neutral units in League of Legends. Unlike minions, monsters do not fight for either team, and will only do so if aggroed (provoked) – with the exception of the Rift Scuttler, which simply runs away when attacked.

League of Legends content
Basic attack
The basic attack (or "auto") is the default means by which a unit deals damage, usually equaling  100% AD physical damage. Basic attacks are normally unit-targeted edge range spells, and the  attack range stat determines their reach.

The caster must stand still to complete a brief windup before launching a basic attack. Depending on the caster:

  • If a caster's attacks are non-projectile (e.g. melee) launching the attack deals damage immediately.
  • If a caster's attacks are projectile, launching the attack sends a projectile that follows the target and deals damage upon striking them.
The caster then incurs a brief cooldown, based on their  attack speed. Basic attacks' damage may trigger on-hit effects only upon dealing damage. On-attack effects will always trigger upon the attack's windup completing.

League of Legends content
Champion ability
A champion ability (often just ability) is a unique action performed by and only available to a specific champion. All of these special moves available to a champion collectively constitute their kit. A skill point is earned each time the champion  levels up, which the player can spend on most abilities to learn them and rank them up to improve their potency.

Champion abilities can have either or both active and passive effects:

  • Active effects are cast by using their respective hotkey and selecting a valid target. Most abilities require spending an amount of resource, such as  mana.
  • Passive effects may simply be permanently available or are cast by fulfilling a requirement or using a specific command.
Most abilities incur a  cooldown after being cast, during which they cannot be used. This cooldown time is usually reduced by  ability haste. Spell effects may trigger only when a valid ability deals damage. On-cast effects trigger upon an ability's cast time completing.

League of Legends content
Aura

An aura is an effect that applies a buff or debuff to surrounding units nearby the source. It uses an area of effect range that affects any valid targets within.

League of Legends content
On-hit effect
On-hit is an umbrella term for a type of effect that triggers on instances of basic damage, or generally upon a basic attack or certain attack-like ability hitting a target. Most on-hit effects deal proc damage or default damage, which are non-reactive (= the effects don't trigger more effects).

  • Critical strikes are not on-hit effects. An ability listed as applying on-hit effects cannot critically strike unless otherwise stated.
  •  Life steal is not an on-hit effect. Damage from on-hit effects normally does not apply life steal, unless those effects deal basic damage or are special-cased to benefit from life steal.

The ability counterpart to on-hit effects are ability effects, which apply on instances of ability damage.

League of Legends content
Champion ability
A champion ability (often just ability) is a unique action performed by and only available to a specific champion. All of these special moves available to a champion collectively constitute their kit. A skill point is earned each time the champion  levels up, which the player can spend on most abilities to learn them and rank them up to improve their potency.

Champion abilities can have either or both active and passive effects:

  • Active effects are cast by using their respective hotkey and selecting a valid target. Most abilities require spending an amount of resource, such as  mana.
  • Passive effects may simply be permanently available or are cast by fulfilling a requirement or using a specific command.
Most abilities incur a  cooldown after being cast, during which they cannot be used. This cooldown time is usually reduced by  ability haste. Spell effects may trigger only when a valid ability deals damage. On-cast effects trigger upon an ability's cast time completing.

League of Legends content
Magic damage
  • Applies:
    • Bloodletter's Curse's Vile Decay (only via abilities)
    • Morellonomicon's and Oblivion Orb's Grievous Wounds
    • Omnivamp
  • Triggers:
    • Hexdrinker's and Maw of Malmortius' Lifeline
  • Mitigated by:
    • Damage shields
    • Invulnerability
    • Damage reduction
    •  Magic resistance
    • Magic shields
League of Legends content
Persistent area damage
Persistent area damage is technically not a separate type of damage, but rather a hybrid classification that is applied to some spells.

In situations where persistent damage and area damage would have conflicting outputs, the conflict is resolved by choosing the weakest possible outcome.

  •  Omnivamp heals with one-third effectiveness for persistent area damage dealt to non-champions, as with persistent damage and area damage.
  • Arcane Comet's  remaining cooldown is reduced by 5% upon dealing an instance of persistent area damage to a champion, as with persistent damage.
  • Jax's Counter Strike grants him 25% damage reduction against all incoming persistent area damage, as with area damage.

League of Legends content
Proc damage
Proc damage is damage type assigned to most on-hit effects. It is worth noting that many seeming on-hit effects are actually classified as ability damage and so will trigger ability effects. Some forms of on-hit damage, such as by Blade of the Ruined King and Spellblade, also benefit from  life steal.

Proc damage does not interact with most other effects, such as Luden's Companion or Arcane Comet. The main exception is:

  • Omnivamp and Physical vamp (where applicable) heal for a percentage of damage dealt.

Effects triggered by damage subtypes ( physical, magic, true) will always occur regardless of damage type (e.g. Black Cleaver's Carve stacking on instances of physical damage and Morellonomicon's Grievous Wounds application on instances of magic damage).

League of Legends content
Structure
A structure is a fixed, immobile unit on the battlefield that exists to control a team's territory and protect their base. Structures include turrets, inhibitors, and the Nexus. The structure unit type is considered an invalid target to most abilities and spells, and can normally only be damaged with basic attacks.

Turrets are heavy fortifications that defend a part of territory. They provide vision of the area and autonomously fire homing bolts at nearby enemies, establishing a defensive ground for allies.

Inhibitors are stone platforms containing an arcane crystal. They are located in each team's base and are each protected by an inhibitor turret standing before them in the same lane. When a team's inhibitor is destroyed, allied super minions will begin spawning in the waves set in the respective lane.

The Nexus is a massive stone platform containing a large arcane crystal. One is located in each team's base and each are protected by two Nexus turrets standing before them. When a team's Nexus is destroyed, they are defeated and the opposing team scores victory of the match, thus ending the game.

League of Legends content
Invulnerability

A unit that is Invulnerable reduces all damage taken to 0 and prevents effects that trigger from damage.

League of Legends content
Spell shield

A spell shield refers to one of several effects that have the capacity to negate hostile abilities from applying to the recipient. A spell shield may negate many active effects coming from champion abilities, epic monsters, champion summoned units, and items, but almost none from runes and summoner spells with the only exceptions of Arcane Comet, Unleashed Smite, and Primal Smite which will be blocked.

  • See the article for more details.
League of Legends content
Dodge
Dodging an instance of damage will skip its damage event entirely, preventing it from being taken and effects that trigger from damage. Dodge takes precedence over block, but not blind.

Effects that dodge damage will only dodge instances that are dodgeable. Note that these are specified in the ability details on the Wiki.

Basic attacks and abilities that apply on-hit effects are always dodged, unless otherwise stated.

This effect is exclusive to Jax's Counter Strike and Nilah's Jubilant Veil.

League of Legends content
Block
Blocking an instance of damage will reduce its value to 0, but does not prevent effects that trigger from damage. Blind and dodge take precedence over block.

Effects that block damage will only block instances that are blockable. Note that these are specified in the ability details on the Wiki.

Basic attacks and abilities that apply on-hit effects are always blocked, unless otherwise stated.

This effect is exclusive to Shen's Spirit's Refuge and is similar though mechanically different to Dodge.

League of Legends content
Blind

A unit that is blinded will miss their basic attacks for the duration, comparable to attacking a target that is able to dodge or block, but not mechanically similar. Missed basic attacks will fail to deal damage and apply on-hit effects, with the exception of some empowered basic attacks. Blind does not prevent the unit from declaring attacks, unlike Disarm.

Interrupts: Does not interrupt any actions, but will prevent on-hit effects from being triggered by basic attacks.
Reduction: The duration is affected by Tenacity.
Resist: Resisted by crowd control immunity.
Removal: Removed by Cleanses with the exception of Mikael's Blessing.
League of Legends content
 Obliterate COOLDOWN: 8 / 7 / 6 / 5 / 4
Active: Mordekaiser smashes the area in the target direction, dealing magic damage to enemies within, increased if it hits only one enemy.
League of Legends content
 Death's Grasp COOLDOWN: 18 / 16 / 14 / 12 / 10
Passive: Mordekaiser gains  magic penetration.
Active: Mordekaiser summons a claw in the target direction that grants sight of the area. After a brief time, it deals magic damage and pulls enemies hit.
League of Legends content
Cast instance

Cast instance is the identifier that tells the source of spells; it is the game's method of associating multiple effects (damage events, buff applications) as originating from a specific, singular attack or ability cast by a unit. Multiple effects occurring under the same cast instance behave as one for certain interactions. Some notable examples:

  • Conqueror's stacking can only be triggered once per cast instance.
  • Electrocute and Phase Rush can only receive 1 stack for their activation per cast instance.
  • Muramana deals its damage once per cast instance.

Not to be confused with damage instance, which is each individual effects, even under the same cast instance.

League of Legends content
Edge range

Edge range is calculated from the edge of a source unit's hitbox to the edge of a target unit's hitbox.

  • Edge range is mostly used for basic attacks; skill shots; and point-blank areas of effect (including auras).
  • These become more effective against large champions, as the source gains more reach against them. This may be favorable or unfavorable: durable champions tend to be larger and thus easier to hit, and frail champions tend to be smaller and more difficult to hit.
League of Legends content
Spell damage

Spell damage is the damage type dealt by most abilities and some items and runes that affect targets directly, usually a single one. Spell damage applies spell effects by default.

  • Arcane Comet's  remaining cooldown is reduced by 20% upon dealing an instance of spell damage to a champion.

Effects triggered by damage subtypes ( physical, magic, true) will always occur regardless of damage type (e.g. Black Cleaver's Carve stacking on instances of physical damage and Morellonomicon's Grievous Wounds application on instances of magic damage).

League of Legends content
Area damage

Area damage is the damage type dealt by most abilities and some items and runes that can hit targets within a zone. Area damage applies spell effects by default.

  • Area damage does not trigger Muramana's Shock; only spell damage can.
  • Arcane Comet's  remaining cooldown is reduced by 10% upon dealing an instance of area damage to a champion.
  • Jax's Counter Strike grants him 25% damage reduction against all incoming area damage.
  • Many champion summoned units such as Elise's Spiderlings, Naafiri's Packmates, and Yorick's Mist Walkers take reduced damage from area damage effects.
  •  Omnivamp heals with 33.3% effectiveness on instances of area damage against non-champions.

Effects triggered by damage subtypes ( physical, magic, true) will always occur regardless of damage type (e.g. Black Cleaver's Carve stacking on instances of physical damage and Morellonomicon's Grievous Wounds application on instances of magic damage).

League of Legends content
Heal

Healing replenishes a unit's  current health, but never above their maximum health.

League of Legends content
Spellblade
Spellblade is a unique named item effect that grants additional effects to the next on-hit trigger after casting a champion ability.

The following items grant Spellblade:

  • Sheen
  • Bloodsong
  • Dusk and Dawn
  • Essence Reaver
  • Iceborn Gauntlet
  • Lich Bane
  • Trinity Force

League of Legends content
 Force Pulse COOLDOWN: 21 / 20 / 19 / 18 / 17
Passive: Ability casts reduce the cooldown of this ability.
Active: Kassadin emits a pulse of void energy in a cone in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies and briefly slows them.
League of Legends content
Sight
Sight is a property of units, structures, certain summoner spells, items, and abilities that represents a team possessing vision of a target area or unit. It is always center range. A line of vision cannot extend beyond terrain or an unrevealed brush.

Sight can also refer to an effect that makes a unit visible regardless of the fog of war or brush, allowing them to be targeted. Standard sight cannot see stealthed units, but True Sight can.

  • Nearsight is a crowd control debuff that inhibits sight; allied vision is lost in addition to a reduced sight radius.
  • Obscured vision is similar to sight in a way that it can observe units, but does not render units targetable, rather it exposes their position and informs of their presence.
  • Unobstructed vision is a form of sight that allows a unit to be able to see their full vision radius, ignoring any obstructions that would otherwise restrict visibility.
  • All effects that use unit-targeting require sight of the target. Delayed unit-targeted attacks and spells can cancel if sight of the selected target is suddenly lost.
